description: This file defines an Angular component 'FaqListComponent' that manages a FAQ list interface, fetching FAQ data from an API service, handling search functionality, and emitting events when a question is selected.

classes.name: FaqListComponent
classes.description: An Angular standalone component that displays a list of FAQs, supports search, and emits events when questions are asked.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches the list of FAQs from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for FAQs based on the query input; fetches all FAQs if the query is empty.

methods.name: askQuestion
methods.description: Emits an event with the selected FAQ question to the parent component.
